schema.regionPolicy: Groups share boundary nodes; region passes never duplicate joints. Dense facial sides honor the source mirror convention.

face.authority: Five editable facial slots; body-detector eye coordinates remain raw evidence, not competing controls.

landmarkExtension.convention: 68-point detector ordering; anatomical anchors map explicitly, not by image x

schema.proportions: character-specific; no mannequin dimensions are canonical

extensions.policy: add namespaced profiles/points; retain unknown JSON fields; no silent dropping

schema.ground: separate user guide or silhouette estimate, not skeletal root and not proven foot contact

corpusMetadata.action_plain: Turn/weight shift into single-leg balance and footstand

tentative_view.notes: Front-dominant with a turn and weight shift.

root_floor_estimate.estimation_method: tracked figure-mask bottom and foot-band median after figure isolation
root_floor_estimate.warning: Provisional corpus estimate; not canonical skeleton tracking.

source_quality.label: GOOD
source_quality.notes: Strong balance, pelvis-tilt and foot-contact evidence; clean blue background and useful view-transition material.
source_quality.caution: Ends in a different pose; the panels are not calibrated stages of one exact turn.
source_quality.assessment_basis: manual frame-by-frame review plus isolated-silhouette diagnostics

isolation.method: chroma foreground contours + left-to-right identity tracking + fixed motion envelope
isolation.ambiguous_overlap_policy: split touching foreground at tracked horizontal identity boundary
isolation.source_figure_merge_note: Raw source frames with fewer separate tall figure silhouettes than expected; these required horizontal identity partitioning.
isolation.residual_component_policy: Dominant mannequin silhouette retained; detached neighboring fragments replaced with sampled background.

documentation.authority: One universal skeleton on one source-indexed timeline. Region passes never create independent tracks.
documentation.editing: points are observations; edits and accepted locks override them. Propagation never overwrites pins or locks.
documentation.source: Source bytes are not embedded in JSON. Save a portable project ZIP to include them.
documentation.confidence: Detector scores are not calibrated probabilities of anatomical correctness; manual points use null confidence.
documentation.scope: Single subject. Dedicated hair/skin/garment/accessory classification is deferred.
